comment: Phase 3 audio bandwidth benchmark. 30s of real webcam footage (corpus-real/cam720.mkv) at call settings (320x240@24 q60 yuv420 motion+ikf+refresh+lz4, keyframe every 120) + mono 16 kHz speech. Wire = QOV-S datagram mode (1180 B fragments, 20 B headers, XOR FEC per qov-streaming-spec section 5.2), computed exactly from the measured chunk size distribution. QOA bitrates are content-independent (fixed-size frames). Reproduce with bench_stream.c + bench_bandwidth.py.
